version.description: The file's format version. Aphelion migrates older ones.

name.description: Unique agent name. Also the name of the agent's folder (decision 0010).

provider.description: The agent CLI that runs the agent.

connectors.description: Ids of the connectors the agent may use. Can be empty.

policyProfile.description: The approval profile the agent's actions pass.

folder.description: Absolute path of the agent's folder. Normally the agent's name under /var/lib/aphelion-agents.

agents.description: One entry per agent. Names must be unique.

title: agents.yaml
description: What each agent is allowed to do. Instructions live in the agent's folder, not here (decision 0010).
